review: Half-filled exclusion-current polishing outcome and prospective domain assessment
reviewer: crystal_plan_review; authored the polishing source, which root independently reviewed and froze before running
diagnosis_confirmed: All 72 profiles meet the tighter polishing target. Forty-six require one Newton step and 26 require none. The largest SCGF change is only 2.51e-10, while the formerly excluded nonuniform profiles now meet the unchanged 1e-6 stationarity gate. The initial 51.54% mismatch was a stopping/selection artifact: the fixed filter had fallen back to the unstable flat stationary point. The original failed screen remains failed; this separately frozen diagnostic resolves its numerical blocker.

gold_assessment.decision: A defensible scientific reference within the published half-filled Bethe/MFT branch is now practical, subject to a bounded domain/reference check and calibration/noise validation. The repository accepts an independent derivation, analytical limit or numerical reference; a new rigorous global-optimum proof is not required.
gold_assessment.independence: The elliptic scalar solution and unrestricted-in-shape spatial optimization agree on the fixed cases with independent discretization and stationarity checks. The microscopic Bethe correspondence supplies published physical support; neither code agreement nor this review proves all thermodynamic assumptions or excludes every time-dependent history.
gold_assessment.public_statement: Specify the fixed half-filled canonical ring, positive exponential rates, counting of successful jumps across every bond, microscopic clock, order of limits, units, inputs and outputs. Do not redefine the observable as a stationary variational problem merely to make the oracle exact. The branch assumptions and citations belong in author/reference documentation.
gold_assessment.completed_shortcut: The homogeneous SCGF is a complete correct implementation of its assumed profile and fits weak-field calibration exactly before measurement noise. Its strong-field failure is a real conditioned-density omission.

prospective_domain.public_ranges: E in [0,12], lambda in [-2E-2,2], D in [0.8,1.2]. This is a small natural continuous domain: E=0 is nonsingular, the bias interval is GC-symmetric and D adds only an exact multiplicative scale.
prospective_domain.prediction_groups: Retain precisely the six screened prediction points and the same two complete groups. Add an exact-limit group separately; never normalize an individual SCGF-zero point by its own zero value.
prospective_domain.recommended_reference_sample: The proposed 62-case check is sufficient but duplicates spatial solves at +/-eta. The direct objective depends exactly on eta^2. The smaller equivalent sample retains predictions first; adds E={6.5,8,10,12}, eta/eta_c={0,.5,.999,1,1.001}, and lambda={0,2}; adds controls (E,lambda)=(0,2),(4,-8),(4,-2),(4,2),(2pi,-2pi). Deduplicate by physical (E,lambda). This gives 37 cases and 222 spatial attempts at grids128/256 with the original three fresh seeds. Check omitted GC mirrors through the elliptic API and the exact identity, without repeated spatial solves.
prospective_domain.sampling_and_gates: Keep 600 seconds, the existing SLSQP followed by the reviewed fixed polish, and every original numerical/separation gate. The profile-contrast gate applies only to the six predictions, not flat or near-critical controls. Retain both grids and every seed. A 201-point root map and 121-point elliptic convexity slice per positive sampled field are cheap supporting diagnostics, not continuum certification.
prospective_domain.convexity_gate_suggestion: For each equally spaced 121-point bias slice require each second finite difference of psi to be >= -1e-9*max(1,max(abs(psi))). Check GC mirrors to the original symmetry tolerance. Freeze this new diagnostic threshold before execution.
prospective_domain.calibration: Use only E<=4 and several nonzero biases so that psi_i=D f_i with f_i=lambda_i(lambda_i+2E_i)/4. Weighted least squares through the origin identifies D; include multiple magnitudes and signs. Six to twelve independent observations are enough for this one parameter before the required 256-noise validation. Set reported measurement errors independently of the hidden true D so sigma does not encode it. Label observations as estimates of the stated asymptotic SCGF, not an undisclosed finite-ring/time observable.
prospective_domain.gold_storage: After the domain check, independent grid256 raw values at the six fixed predictions can supply verifier gold, with elliptic agreement and both-grid provenance retained. Exact D scaling avoids new PDE/grid solves at D endpoints. The prospective 60-second verifier need not rerun optimization.
prospective_domain.status: Conceptual proposal only; no domain source, study or task package was created or run by this reviewer.

limitations: The first failed numerical screen remains in the evidence chain.
The present pass covers only the fixed 12 cases and cannot certify the full continuous public domain.
No calibration/noise validation, Docker controls, package or model trial has been performed for this proposal.
actions: Read and reduce retained results, check hashes/selection and review task-authoring rules. No new science executed during this review.
